Williams (2012: 260), Encyonopsis cesatii (Rabenhorst 1853: 39) Krammer (1997 b: 156), Gomphonella olivacea (Hornemann 1810: fasc. 24, pl. 1429) Rabenhorst (1853: 61), Gomphonema tergestinum (Grunow in Van Heurck 1880: pl. 25, fig. 40) Fricke in A. Schmidt (1902: pl. 234, figs 39 – 43), Navicula cryptotenella Lange-Bertalot in Krammer & Lange-Bertalot (1985: 62) and Nitzschia media Hantzsch (1860: 40).
